name: humcase
description: Humcase skills so Codex resumes work, files and writes cases, and delivers results the person accepts or sends back for rework.

interface.shortDescription: Resume, file and deliver work tracked in Humcase
interface.longDescription: Skills for the Humcase desktop app: reload the brief and the reworks the person asked for, write cases faithful to what was said, file them as sub-cases of the right subject, and resolve them only after verification with a report. The Humcase MCP server is declared in ~/.codex/config.toml, because a Codex plugin cannot ask for the path of Humcase.exe (see docs/AGENT_SETUP.md).
defaultPrompt: Where are we? Reload the Humcase brief for this project.
Log this bug in Humcase, inside the case it belongs to.
Handle the reworks waiting in Humcase.
